newsitem.title: USA: Transocean Offshore wins $124 mln project.
newsitem.headline: Transocean Offshore wins $124 mln project.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said Wednesday it has been awarded a three-well turnkey drilling project by Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex), the national oil company of Mexico.

The project is expected to begin by late-February 1997, with an estimated duration of two-years, including well testing services. Total value of the project is an estimated $124 million, including all anticipated daywork services to follow the turnkey drilling phase of each well.

The three-well program includes two delineation wells and one wildcat well, each in up to 600 feet of water in the Bay of Campeche. The wells will be drilled by the Discoverer 511, a turret-moored drillship owned by Ghana National Petroleum Corporation (GNPC) and bareboat chartered for a minimum of two-years by Transocean Offshore.

The rig is currently in a U.S. Gulf Coast shipyard undergoing a short refurbishment and upgrade program. Shipyard activities, which include the installation of a top drive, are expected to be completed by mid-February, 1997.

Upgrade and refurbishment costs incurred on the Discoverer 511 while in the shipyard will be shared by Transocean Offshore and GNPC, with Transocean Offshore primarily responsible for the installation of an existing top drive system and shipyard supervision, a total amount which is not expected to exceed $3.0 million.

Transocean Offshore Inc. has provided turnkey drilling services in Mexico since 1990, having successfully completed three turnkey packages totaling 15 wells over the six year period. The company is the only western drilling contractor to have maintained a continuous turnkey operation in the country since 1992.

Extensive geologic intelligence of the Bay of Campeche has been obtained over this period and will play an important role in the success of current and future projects. Pemex has tendered a total of seven turnkey packages since late December, 1996 with the current three-well package representing the only award to date. Transocean Offshore is currently evaluating all tendered programs.
